description: This source file implements the SetMute class, which manages muting functionality for a media pipeline within a GStreamer-based media player. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute methods that interact with GStreamer to set the mute state.

classes.name: SetMute
classes.description: A class responsible for setting the mute state of a media stream within a GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: SetMute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetMute object with context, a GStreamer wrapper, and mute state.

methods.name: ~SetMute
methods.description: Destructor that handles cleanup for the SetMute object.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the mute operation by calling GStreamer functions to set the mute state.
